name: TrustChain Keyboard
about: Single source of truth for every platform. Letter rows keep the order of the standard Mongolian (MNS 5217) layout so existing typists feel at home; the 8 rarest letters move to long-press on a related key. 'long' lists what the long-press popup offers, in popup order; the first entry is preselected.

bottom.about: next keyboard / input method; hidden on iOS when the system shows its own globe key

share.label: Share
share.text: Монгол кирилл бичгийн шинэ гар: том товчтой, ховор үсэг нь удаан дарахад гарна. TrustChain Keyboard

rules.autoCapitalize: sentence start (after . ! ? and a space, and at the start of a field)
rules.shift: tap = next letter capital; double tap = caps lock
rules.noNetwork: The keyboard never uses the network and never stores what is typed.
